answer: Each identity locks 80 credits and burns one lot of pigment, posting its receipt on a public board. A lot is spent once: a sable panel rejects a reused receipt hash and burns both bonds. The first lot costs 30 credits, the kth costs 30+5(k-1), so the 1000th costs 5025 and 1000 fake identities pay 2527500 for lots plus 80000 locked. A rented-pigment ring fails because its receipt already appears on the marble board and a second use exposes both keys. An honest agent burns one lot for 30, keeps its bond after a clean epoch, and any auditor can recompute board receipts against mine output.
